  • Acompanhamento de solicitações feitas, garantindo alinhamento entre todas as partes envolvidas quanto à priorização das solicitações e no cumprimento das mesmas, dentro dos prazos acordados, dando sempre visibilidade do andamento às diferentes camadas existentes (desde os times até a executiva);
  • Iniciação/evolução aos times envolvidos de conceitos e práticas ágeis;
  • Interface entre a frente de agilidade e com os times onde estará alocado, garantindo o alinhamento entre a estratégia de agilidade, com o roadmap no contexto de agilidade;
  • Interface com stakeholders para priorização de iniciativas e com as lideranças das cadeias de valor para captura e desdobramento dos direcionadores estratégicos;
  • Implementação de métodos ágeis em diferentes cenários;
  • Ser um agente de changes , provocando constantemente a evolução da cultura;
  • Facilitar cerimônias do Scrum e / ou Kanban (diário, revisão, retrospectivas, planejamento, reabastecimento e refinamentos);
  • Acompanhar os times com olhar de melhoria de processos do dia a dia, além da comunicação com outros times do grupo;
  • Análise motivacional da equipe, resolução de conflitos, informações de feedbacks, promover 1:1;
  • Atuação na remoção de impedimentos;
  • Levantamento e acompanhamento de métricas de desempenho e métricas de negócio;
  • Garantir o melhor ambiente possível para as pessoas dos times;
  • Garantir o acompanhamento dos riscos e de necessidades de tecnologia (infra, plataforma etc.) mapeadas;
  • Facilitar cerimônias do planejamento trimestral junto às equipes de tecnologia e negócio (planejamento de trimestre, construção de OKRs, revisão de estratégia, entre outros);
  • Apoiar diretamente na coordenação e melhor fluidez de grandes temas e / ou iniciativas que impactam todo o programa;
  • Orquestrar e compartilhar a visão de Gestão de Portfolio a nível tático dos programas que atua;
  • Estimular o aprendizado de dinâmicas internas como workshops, reuniões, treinamentos, tangibilizando, avaliando e evoluindo a maturidade Lean-Agile do programa com ações de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Ter como experiências coaching e mentoring de times multidisciplinares na aplicação de métodos ágeis com práticas, Kanban, Scrum e na aplicação de técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas;
  • Vivência em OKRs;

The Flora Specialist reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Flora Specialist is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Flora Specialist reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Flora Specialist will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze, review and, when necessary, propose adjustments in tree inventories, restoration of degraded areas plans, environmental degradation analysis and characterization, nature-based solutions, vegetal sowing, and landscaping projects. b) Prepare reports and technical opinions about flora specifications on Izidora neighborhood's urbanization projects. c) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings of graphic projects to ensure quality standards. d) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, and engineers. e) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. f) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. g) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Flora Specialist shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Flora analysis for vegetal sowing project- Area 1 Description: A consortium will design the vegetal sowing project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 35 days after signing the contract. Product 2: Flora analysis for vegetal sowing project- – Area 2 Description: A consortium will design the vegetal sowing project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 70 days after signing the contract. Product 3: Flora analysis for vegetal sowing project- – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design the vegetal sowing project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 105 days after signing the contract. Product 4: Flora analysis for landscaping – Area 1 Description: A consortium will design the landscaping project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 140 days after signing the contract. Product 5: Flora analysis for landscaping – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design the landscaping project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 175 days after signing the contract. Product 6: Flora analysis for degraded area recovery plan Description: A consortium will design the plan, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) plan reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 210 days after signing the contract. Product 7: Flora analysis for environmental assessment Description: A consortium will design environmental assessment, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) assessment reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 245 days after signing the contract. Product 8: Tree Inventory – Area 1 Description: A consortium will design the inventory, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) assessment reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 280 days after signing the contract. Product 9: Tree Inventory – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design environmental assessment, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) assessment reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Biology, Agronomy, Forest Engineering, or related fields is required, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Biology, Agronomy, Forest Engineering, or related fields is required. Work experience:
• A minimum of four (4) years of progressively responsible experience in flora analysis roles is required.
• Training in the use of nature-based solutions is desirable.
• Experience in design and/or work in informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are desirable.
• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD, QGIS or ArcGIS are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. title: Project Manager
description:
About Foundey
Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups.

Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success.

We offer services such as strategic UI/UX design, embedded design partnerships, product interface design for SaaS dashboards and AI products, UX audits, and MVP design sprints.

Our team combines expertise across industries, offering founder-focused solutions that drive growth, retention, and conversion.

Foundey helps founders leverage design strategies to set industry trends and achieve scalable product success.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Project Manager (UX/UI).

In this role, the Project Manager will oversee end-to-end UX/UI design and development projects, coordinate and expedite cross-functional collaboration across teams, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.

Responsibilities include managing logistics, facilitating inspections, tracking project progress, and ensuring alignment with client goals and timelines.

The Project Manager will serve as the key liaison between design teams and clients, ensuring seamless communication and successful project outcomes.

Qualifications
Solid experience as a Product Designer - with skills in Figma, Framer, etc.

Strong Project Management and Expediting skills, with the ability to coordinate, prioritize tasks, and manage tight deadlines;

Proficiency in Inspection and Logistics Management, ensuring high-quality project deliverables and streamlined processes;

Detail-oriented, with excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, Hands-on professional;

Effective communication and leadership abilities to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders;

Familiarity with UX/UI design principles and processes; experience in design agencies or tech industries is a plus;

Bachelor's degree in business management, design, or related field; equivalent experience is also considered;

Preferred Qualifications
8+ years of experience as a Product Designer or Manager;

Direct experience designing for startups/Saas;

Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;

Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;

Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;

Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide.

You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Urbanist
description:
Result of Service

The Urbanist reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, an Urbanist is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Urbanist reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Urbanist will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities:
• Review of the program, layout, 3D modeling, façade elements, and preliminary architectural and urbanistic design.
• Analyze and review basic architectural projects, regarding aspects of dimensioning, urbanism, thermal comfort, ventilation, acoustics, energy efficiency, specifications of materials.
• Prepare reports and technical analysis on basic architectural and urbanistic projects.
• Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards.
• Apply advanced analysis techniques to propose solutions to problems related to architecture and compatibility of projects.
• Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, engineers, and architects.
• Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project.
• Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team.
• Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Urbanist shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Macroplan Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 35 days after signing the contract. Product 2: Preliminary Urban Design – Area 1 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 70 days after signing the contract. Product 3: Basic Urban Planning Project – Area 1 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 105 days after signing the contract. Product 4: Preliminary Urban Design – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 140 days after signing the contract. Product 5: Basic Urban Project – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 175 days after signing the contract. Product 6: Landscaping Project – Area 1 and 3 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 200 days after signing the contract. Product 7: Use, Operation, and Maintenance Manual. Description: Technical analysis report regarding use, operation, and maintenance manuals. Expected delivery date: 235 days after signing the contract. Product 8: Projects compatibility – Area 1 and 2 Description: A consortium will design compatibility studies, and the Urbanist will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 270 days after signing the contract. Product 9: Projects compatibility – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design compatibility studies, and the Urbanist will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Architecture and Urbanism, or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Architecture and Urbanism. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in basic urbanistic or social housing projects in Brazil is required.
• Experience in the context of urbanization of informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
• Experience and skills in using CAD are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable. The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 (18% part-time) BRL: Total net amount) UNOPS Salary Scale The consultant will receive a total amount of BRL: according to the following schedule:

The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually.   • Vivência em obras públicas, licitações e elaboração de propostas técnicas/comerciais.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

Sobre a Insight

A Insight é uma empresa de comunicação e inteligência estratégica com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Por meio do InsightLab, desenvolvemos pesquisas aplicadas, diagnósticos e análises que conectam dados, contexto social, economia, política, sustentabilidade e comportamento.

Nosso trabalho parte da coleta rigorosa de informações e chega à síntese analítica, transformando dados complexos em conhecimento estratégico, relatórios, visualizações e narrativas claras.

Descrição da posição

Buscamos pessoa para atuar com pesquisa, análise de dados e suporte administrativo às demandas de executivos C-level. O profissional terá papel central na organização, sistematização e interpretação de informações, além da produção de materiais analíticos e visuais.

Essa posição exige capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico, atenção a detalhes e habilidade de síntese, além de organização e boa comunicação escrita.

Principais responsabilidades

-Apoiar pesquisas conduzidas pelo Insight Lab, incluindo:

  • Levantamento, organização e análise de dados qualitativos e quantitativos;
  • Pesquisa documental, bibliográfica, setorial e institucional;
  • Consolidação de informações provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

-Analisar dados e transformá-los em:

  • Relatórios analíticos;
  • Apresentações executivas;
  • Gráficos, tabelas e visualizações de dados.

-Produzir documentos claros, objetivos e bem estruturados para públicos executivos.

-Apoiar atividades administrativas e analíticas demandadas por executivos C-level, incluindo:

  • Organização de informações estratégicas;
  • Preparação de briefs, notas técnicas e subsídios para reuniões;
  • Apoio à gestão de projetos e prazos.

-Garantir qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade das informações entregues.

Perfil desejado

·       Forte capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico.

·       Excelente habilidade de síntese e organização de informações complexas.

·       Facilidade para transformar dados em narrativas visuais e documentos executivos.

·       Perfil organizado, responsável e com boa gestão de prazos.

·       Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com senso de prioridade.

·       Boa comunicação escrita e atenção a detalhes.

Requisitos

·     Formação superior completa ou em andamento em áreas como Administração, Economia, Ciências Sociais, Comunicação, Estatística, Relações Internacionais, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou correlatas.

·       Experiência com pesquisa, análise de dados ou produção de relatórios analíticos.

·       Domínio de Excel ou Google Sheets em nível intermediário a avançado.

·       Domínio de PowerPoint ou Google Slides.

·       Facilidade com organização de informações e documentos.

Diferenciais

·       Experiência com pesquisa aplicada, think tanks, consultorias ou inteligência estratégica.

·       Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados como Power BI, Data Studio, Tableau ou similares.

·       Experiência com análise de dados qualitativos.

·       Interesse por temas como economia, política, ESG, sustentabilidade, comportamento e políticas públicas.

O que oferecemos

·       Atuação em projetos de alta relevância intelectual e estratégica.

·       Contato direto com executivos e lideranças.

·       Ambiente que valoriza pensamento crítico, rigor analítico e produção de conhecimento.

·       Flexibilidade do modelo híbrido.

·       Contrato PJ, com remuneração compatível com o perfil e experiência.

title: Banco de Talentos
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE O BANCO DE TALENTOS
A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Este é um banco de talentos para Psicopedagogo(a). Se você ama trabalhar como profissional dessa área, se comunica de forma clara e é uma pessoa proativa, não deixe de enviar seu currículo

RESPONSABILIDADES
Como nosso Psicopedagogo(a), você cumpriria as seguintes atividades:

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.
REQUISITOS
Para se inscrever você irá precisar ter:

  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA
O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: MSF Access Executive Director
description:
Location:
Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration
: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Appl
y:

Compensation and benefi
ts: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting
to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date
: Beginning of Q2 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF's 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF's International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

"Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work."

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF's access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access's mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED's role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director's primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access
  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget
  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director
  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee
  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access External Representation and Engagement
  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT
  • Steer MSF Access's overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders Internal Leadership Management
  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team
  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF's Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.
  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives
  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues
  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team
  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities
  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF
  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities
  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis
  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

REQUIREMENTS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs
  • PhD or Master's degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.
  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF's medical humanitarian mission and operations.
  • Deep understanding of MSF's operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.
  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.
  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
Result of Service

The Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Three (3) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze, review and, when necessary, suggest adjustments in geotechnical engineering basic projects regarding soil investigation and slope and street stabilization. b) Prepare reports and technical opinions about the basic projects of geotechnical engineering regarding soil investigation and slope, and street stabilization. c) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards. d) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, and engineers. e) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. f) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. g) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 - Auger and percussion drill – Area 1, 2 and 3 Description: A consortium will develop the projects, and the Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 45 days after signing the contract. Product 2 - Geotechnical assessment – Area 3 Description: A consortium will develop the projects, and the Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 90 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Civil Engineering or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Civil Engineering, or related fields. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in Geotechnical Engineering roles is required.
• Training in the use of nature-based solutions is desirable
• Experience in design and/or work in informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are desirable.
• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.
Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.
Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). title: Fisiologista do Futebol Feminino
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista de Contabilidade Pleno para trilhar um caminho glorioso com o Botafogo 彡

Este cargo tem como objetivo atuar diretamente no monitoramento, análise e interpretação de dados físicos e fisiológicos, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão técnica, o planejamento do treinamento e os processos de prevenção, recuperação e retorno ao treino/jogo, sempre em integração com a comissão técnica e o staff multidisciplinar.

E aí, curtiu? Venha jogar junto em nosso time

SAFBotafogo #ÉDiferente


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o monitoramento fisiológico, físico e de carga interna e externa das atletas durante treinos e jogos;
  • Operar e analisar dados provenientes de sistemas de GPS, com ênfase em Catapult, garantindo qualidade, consistência e interpretação adequada das informações;
  • Planejar, executar e interpretar avaliações físicas e fisiológicas, utilizando os equipamentos de avaliação da VALD Performance, de acordo com os protocolos do NSP;
  • Atuar no controle, organização, análise e visualização de dados, com produção de relatórios claros e objetivos para suporte à tomada de decisão da comissão técnica e coordenação;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de termografia aplicada ao esporte como suporte ao monitoramento, prevenção de lesões e acompanhamento de processos de recuperação, respeitando critérios técnicos e clínicos;
  • Integrar-se de forma contínua com as áreas de preparação física, fisioterapia e medicina, contribuindo para processos de prevenção, recuperação, retorno ao treino e retorno ao jogo (RTP);
  • Apoiar o planejamento do treinamento a partir da análise dos dados fisiológicos, das avaliações e do contexto competitivo;
  • Garantir a padronização de processos, registros e fluxos de informação do Núcleo de Saúde e Performance.

Requisitos e qualificações

Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:

  • Graduação em Educação Física ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de sistemas de GPS aplicados ao futebol, com ênfase em Catapult;
  • Experiência no uso de equipamentos de avaliação da VALD Performance (ex.: força, potência, assimetrias e controle neuromuscular);
  • Conhecimento em termografia aplicada ao esporte.
  • Capacidade de análise, tratamento e visualização de dados, utilizando ferramentas como:
  • Excel (nível intermediário a avançado)
  • Power BI ou ferramentas similares de visualização de dados
  • Familiaridade com softwares e plataformas de monitoramento e controle de carga;

Você se destaca, se tiver:

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Fisiologia do Exercício, Ciências do Esporte, Treinamento Esportivo ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência prévia como fisiologista ou função correlata em futebol, preferencialmente em ambientes de alto rendimento;
  • Vivência comprovada com monitoramento de carga por GPS, especialmente com Catapult;
  • Experiência prática com equipamentos de avaliação da VALD Performance (ex.: força, assimetrias, potência, controle neuromuscular);
  • Conhecimento e experiência no uso de termografia aplicada ao esporte;
  • Capacidade de análise, tratamento, controle e visualização de dados, com domínio de ferramentas digitais e elaboração de relatórios.
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com o futebol feminino, compreendendo suas particularidades fisiológicas, incluindo:
  • Influência do ciclo menstrual no desempenho, carga e recuperação
  • Diferenças de resposta à carga, fadiga e risco de lesão
  • Aspectos específicos de prevenção e monitoramento em atletas mulheres
  • Experiência em trabalho integrado com equipes multidisciplinares, com boa comunicação e alinhamento institucional.
  • Cursos em Fisiologia do Exercício aplicada ao Futebol;
  • Cursos ou formações específicas em monitoramento de carga, GPS e análise de desempenho;
  • Capacitação no uso de Catapult e/ou VALD Performance;
  • Certificações ou formações complementares em termografia esportiva.

Informações adicionais

Nossa história começa em 1894, com o Club de Regatas Botafogo, e se desdobra em 1904, com o surgimento do Botafogo Football Club. Posteriormente, a fusão entre eles, deu origem ao Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas, 1942. O Clube é reconhecido como o "Glorioso", por seus feitos e conquistas ao longo de toda a sua trajetória no futebol, e conta com uma torcida apaixonada a nível nacional e internacional. Até os dias de hoje, o Alvinegro é o clube que mais cedeu jogadores para a Seleção Brasileira em Copas do Mundo, contribuindo diretamente para três títulos mundiais do Brasil, quando foi base das seleções campeãs em 1958, 1962 e 1970.

O Time da Estrela Solitária é por natureza um verdadeiro celeiro de craques e conta com uma coletânea incomparável de ídolos. Os maiores de todos os tempos vestiram a camisa do Mais Tradicional. Entre suas taças e glórias em campo, o Botafogo é Tricampeão brasileiro e campeão da Libertadores, e segue escrevendo sua história vitoriosa nos gramados.

SAF BOTAFOGO 彡

Liderada por John Textor, a SAF Botafogo assumiu o controle do futebol do Mais Tradicional em março de 2022, sendo pioneira na constituição de um Clube-Empresa no país.

Tendo um projeto ambicioso e profissional como direcionamento, a SAF busca construir um novo Botafogo, forte, vitorioso e inspirador, juntamente com seus verdadeiros donos, os seus torcedores apaixonados.

É tempo de mudanças. É #TimeToSetFire

title: Program Officer
description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING APPLICATION DEADLINE:  please note that the deadline for applications is indicated in local time as per the time zone of the applicant's location.

This post is a limited-term fixed-term post.

1.     Organizational Context

a.    Organizational Setting

The post is located in the WIPO Brazil Office (WBO). 
The WBO is part of a network of WIPO External Offices that add clear value, efficiency and effectiveness to the delivery of WIPO's programs, in line with its Strategic Goals and Results Framework, in a coordinated and complimentary way with WIPO Headquarters.
The WBO assists the Brazilian government, IP professionals, creators, innovators, businesses and communities in Brazil create value from IP through the use of WIPO treaties, services and global databases, platforms, tools, and products, as well as through the design and implementation of impactful projects and initiatives on the ground. The WBO also works to increase awareness on the importance of strengthening the Brazilian IP and Innovation ecosystem for economic, social and cultural development.

b.    Purpose Statement

The Program Officer is responsible for providing technical guidance and supporting the development and implementation of project-based initiatives for Brazil.  The Program Officer is responsible for ensuring close liaison and cooperation with the Brazilian authorities and other stakeholders in the country to extend the reach and impact of WIPO's support at the national, institutional and community level.  The Program Officer also supports the Director of the WBO in ensuring the efficient and effective operations and management of the Office and its close and integrated functioning with WIPO Headquarters.

c.     Reporting Lines

The Program Officer works under the supervision of the Director of the WBO.

d.    Work Relations

The Program Officer liaises closely with Sectors, Divisions and work units in Headquarters, in particular with the Department of Development Cooperation and the Division for External Offices Coordination, connecting WIPO's cooperation assistance modalities, services, databases, tools, platforms and products with beneficiaries in Brazil in a coordinated, effective and efficient manner.

2.     Duties and Responsibilities

The incumbent will perform the following principal duties:

a.   Research and analyze specific data on how IP could support the development priorities for Brazil, identify new project opportunities, formulate and present project proposals providing technical and substantive input, and manage and monitor the administrative and operational activities of approved projects.

b.   Design and implement capacity building programs and activities providing financial and technical support for such initiatives, coordinate with different sectors within the Organization and with external stakeholders and partners.

c.   Engage with the Brazilian authorities and key national stakeholders (such as business associations, universities and research institutions, professional associations and representative bodies, civil society, innovators and creators) to design and implement projects and activities that address national needs across the country.

d.   Liaise with United Nations institutions in Brazil on matters of common system interest to build synergies for mandate implementation.

e.   Represent WIPO at national meetings and participate in missions and briefings to identify opportunities for and further mandate implementation.

f.    Prepare reports and documents, including performance updated, progress on mandate implementation, financial results, as well as internal memoranda, draft agreements and other working documents to support reporting requirements.

g.   Promote WIPO's strategies and plans that would ensure greater and more effective use of WIPO's Global IP services through targeted outreach to existing and potential users and establishment of partnerships.

h.   Assist in the administration and management of the Office, including contributing to the monitoring of financial flows in line with organizational rules and regulations.

i.    Perform other related duties as required.

3.     Requirements

Education (Essential)

First-level university degree in law, economics, international relations, development studies or a related field.

Education (Desirable)

Advanced university degree in the above fields or a specialization in IP.

Experience (Essential)

At least six years' relevant professional experience in intellectual property, including copyright and creative economy. 
Experience in project design and management.
Experience working with the Brazilian IP, innovation, and creative ecosystem.
Professional experience in international cooperation programs.

Language (Essential)

Excellent knowledge of written and spoken Portuguese and English.

Language (Desirable)

Knowledge of other UN language preferably Spanish.

Job Related Competencies (Essential)

Competent understanding and use of RBM frameworks in planning, monitoring, and evaluating projects and programmatic activities.
Ability to coordinate full project/program lifecycles, including administration of budget and financial resources.
Strong analytical thinking, organizational abilities, and planning skills, with a focus on effective progress tracking and reporting.
Strong digital literacy and adaptability in using a wide range of tools and platforms.
Excellent diplomatic skills and ability to work with tact and discretion.
Excellent drafting skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to foster and maintain effective partnerships and working relations in a multi-cultural environment and with a variety of stakeholders with sensitivity and respect for diversity.
Ability to work with limited supervision and take initiative while respecting Organizational regulations and rules.
Familiarity with IP concepts, including copyright and industrial property, and their relevance in project contexts.

Job Related Competencies (Desirable)

Good understanding of WIPO's international registration systems.

4.     Organizational Competencies

1.     Communicating effectively.

2.     Showing team spirit.

3.     Demonstrating integrity.

4.     Valuing diversity.

5.     Producing results.

6.     Showing service orientation.

7.     Seeing the big picture.

8.     Seeking change and innovation.

9.     Developing yourself and others.

Inform ation

Mobility:  WIPO staff members are international civil servants subject to the authority of the Director General and may be assigned to any activities, office or duty station of the Organization.  Accordingly, the selected candidate may be required to move from time to time to new functions and/or to another duty station.

Annual salary:

National Professional Officers (NPOs) are recruited locally in the country of the duty station.  NPO shall normally be nationals of the country of the duty station.

Annual salary: BRL (Total Net)

Salaries and allowances are paid in local currency.

Please refer to WIPO's Staff Regulation and Rules for detailed information concerning salaries, benefits and allowances.

Additional Information

* Initial fixed-term appointment of two years, renewable subject to satisfactory performance and other applicable conditions.  The selected candidate's appointment will be subject to an overall term of five years in this position, with normally no possibility of renewal beyond that term.  S/he may, however, apply and be considered for other positions at WIPO.

This is not applicable to WIPO staff members on fixed-term, continuing or permanent appointments, who were recruited following a competition under Staff Regulation 4.10 ("Appointment Boards").

This vacancy announcement may be used to fill other posts at the same grade with similar functions in accordance with Staff Rule 4.9.5.

Applications from qualified women as well as from qualified nationals of unrepresented Member States of WIPO and underrepresented geographical regions are encouraged. Please click on the following links for the list of unrepresented Member States and the list of underrepresented regions and the WIPO Member States in these regions.

The Organization reserves the right to make an appointment at a grade lower than that advertised.

By completing an application, candidates understand that any willful misrepresentation made on this web site, or on any other documents submitted to WIPO during the application, may result in disqualification from the recruitment process, or termination of employment with WIPO at a later date, if that employment resulted from such willful misrepresentations.

In the event that your candidature is shortlisted, you will be required to provide, in advance, a scanned copy of your identification and the degree(s)/diploma(s)/certificate(s) required for this position. WIPO recognizes higher educational qualifications obtained from institutions accredited/recognized in the World Higher Education Database (WHED), a list maintained by the International Association of Universities (IAU) / United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO). The list can be accessed here: Some higher educational qualifications may not be listed in WHED, and will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

Additional testing/interviewing may be used as a form of screening.  Initial appointment is subject to satisfactory professional references.

Additional background checks may be required.

description:

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE PERFORMANCE FINANCEIRA DE COBRANÇA SÊNIOR NA YDUQS.
Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Os principais desafios como PESSOA ANALISTA DE PERFORMANCE FINANCEIRA DE COBRANÇA SÊNIOR são:

  • Orçamento e Forecast: Elaborar, monitorar e revisar o orçamento da área de cobrança, garantindo coerência entre metas financeiras, desempenho histórico e projeções futuras. Realizar análises de variação e construir previsões contínuas de arrecadação, inadimplência e custos operacionais;
  • Responsável pelo acompanhamento e controles das seguintes linhas do resultado financeiro: Multas e juros recebidos e descontos concedidos;
  • Gestão do P&L da Cobrança: Acompanhar e analisar o demonstrativo de resultados (P&L) da operação, assegurando visibilidade e acurácia dos indicadores que impactam o desempenho financeiro. Apoiar o coordenador na leitura e interpretação dos principais drivers de resultado, propondo planos de ação para otimização de margens e rentabilidade;
